result.summary: Found 2 major layout issues: content is cut off at the edges of the viewport, affecting the visibility of restaurant cards and category filters.

issues.description: Third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section is partially cut off on the right side (Trattoria Piccol card only shows ~60% of content)
issues.suggestion: Ensure all carousel cards are fully visible within the viewport by adjusting container width, padding, or implementing proper overflow handling

issues.description: Bottom section content is cut off - the second restaurant card in 'Popular right now' section (pizza image with -20% discount) is truncated at the bottom with restaurant name and details not visible
issues.suggestion: Adjust page layout or scrollable container height to ensure all content sections are fully visible, or implement proper scroll behavior

issues.description: Category filter row has potential overflow - appears to cut off after 'Healthy' category, suggesting more categories exist but aren't fully visible
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontal scrolling is properly enabled for category filters or use a more compact layout to display all categories
